title: Tiny Brutalism on Steam
excerpt: Tiny Brutalism is a relaxing diorama building game based on brutalist architecture. Create strange monuments, impossible structures, concrete towers, or just a really big wall. Then explore inside them in first person. There’s no goal and no right way to build. Make whatever you feel like making.

About This Game

Tiny Brutalism is a relaxing diorama sandbox builder inspired by brutalist architecture.

Create your dream mega structure:

  • 20+ Building Blocks - Fit with procedurally generated buildings, bridges, towers, stairs, and nature!

  • First Person Mode - Immerse yourself in your own creations! Explore what you've built from the eyes of a citizen. Yes you can also jump around and parkour if you want to.

  • Weather System - Day/Night cycle, summon rain and fog, you control the environment!

There’s no goal and no right way to build. Just create your own brutalist utopia!

Join the Discord to request features and show off your creations with other Tiny Architects!
